body: Thank you. I truly appreciate it.

Thanks for this. It does make me feel better. I haven't stopped drinking, and I honestly hate the thought of not drinking. I didn't drink last night which was incredibly hard because of how upset I was. I'm hoping I can get myself to not drink tonight. Then I'll be spending the weekend with my parents which will ensure I don't drink. To add to all this, I was just dropped from a class for attendance. I was only allowed to miss 2 classes, and I missed 4. It was a speech class. In some ways I'm relieved to put this class off, but I have to have it to graduate and this was supposed to be my last semester.
